title: tie-credit-llm-judges: Tie-credit tool and re-scoring code
description: Code for the paper "How Much of a Language Model Judge's Kendall Tau Comes from Ties? Re-scoring Published Comparisons with Tie Credit". Contains tiecredit (a single-file Python tool that splits Kendall's tau-b into a tie-free part and tie credit, with bootstrap intervals, Somers' D and pair accuracy), the re-scoring code for four published LLM-judge studies, the scripts for the 2026 current-judge run, and the checks in Appendix B.
